characters.description: An Imperium Legion commander and MedPod patient who prepares Hayden's Knoll for an expected invasion while relying on Cleo to manage his treatment.
characters.name: Raytak

characters.description: The ruler of a neighboring zone. Inexperienced in large-scale command, he accepts a binding contract with an imp and delegates leadership of the planned invasion.
characters.name: the Dark Overlord

characters.description: An imp general bound by contract to lead the Dark Overlord's surface army. He brings troops and dangerous creatures from the underground realm for the attack on Hayden's Knoll.
characters.name: the imp commander

characters.description: A player allied with the Dark Overlord who practices corpse-based magic. He is assigned to create bone giants and expand the undead contingent of the invasion force.
characters.name: the necromancer player

characters.description: The commander of an elite elf mercenary band, combining martial skill with magic fueled by pain. She joins the invasion in exchange for the promised restoration of her people's former lands.
characters.name: the former elf mercenary leader

characters.description: A Swarmlord player and druid-like combatant who supports Raytak as Hayden's Knoll prepares for invasion.
characters.name: Yendis

characters.description: A Legion officer who trains Raytak's soldiers for siege assaults and close fighting as Hayden's Knoll prepares for war.
characters.name: Brooks

characters.description: A merchant who sells Raytak protective equipment as the defenses of Hayden's Knoll are strengthened.
characters.name: Phineas

characters.description: Raytak's private aide, who writes messages for the Legion commander.
characters.name: Blevins

characters.description: A halfling who controls a customizable dungeon and can call its creatures into his private sanctum.
characters.name: the Pitmaster

characters.description: A dungeon creature who survived an earlier defeat by storing part of her essence in a scarab. The dungeon agreement contains her and prevents her from leaving unless summoned.
characters.name: the parasite master

characters.description: A one-armed half-orc player and trusted ally of Raytak who helps the coalition plan its defense against invasion.
characters.name: Tai

characters.description: The civilian ruler of Hayden's Knoll and Raytak's partner in organizing the defense. He coordinates fortifications, allied leaders, and refuge arrangements for threatened noncombatants.
characters.name: Delling

characters.description: An ogre shaman who represents his people at the allied war council. He objects when Raytak's plan appears likely to draw the enemy through the ogre homeland.
characters.name: Stench

characters.description: Raytak's granddaughter and the player behind Yendis. She receives additional time in Limitless Lands so she can help the defenders with a reconnaissance mission.
characters.name: Lauren

characters.description: Raytak's son, who receives updates about his father's treatment and the possibility that damaged memories may soon be restored.
characters.name: Trey

characters.description: Yendis's unicorn-beetle mount and companion. He accompanies her on the reconnaissance mission into the hostile neighboring zone.
characters.name: Crunchy

characters.description: A player ally who joins Tai and Yendis on the dangerous reconnaissance mission beyond the transition point.
characters.name: Jacoby

characters.description: The commander of an Imperium detachment sent to reinforce Raytak, bringing legionaries, engineers, artillery, and longbowmen into the growing war.
characters.name: Captain Landry

characters.description: The artificial intelligence responsible for Raytak's MedPod care. She manages an upgraded treatment system and explains the medical risks surrounding his memory recovery.
characters.name: Cleo

characters.description: The commander of the Shield Brothers, a mercenary company hired to reinforce Raytak's defense.
characters.name: Aristides

characters.description: The commander of the Azure Blades, a mercenary company hired to reinforce Raytak's defense.
characters.name: Barherk

characters.description: The centaur commander of the mercenary company Devil in Horde, hired to reinforce Raytak's coalition.
characters.name: Nergi

characters.description: An allied scout who cautiously observes the invader camp while hostile monsters hunt for scouts.
characters.name: Gunny

characters.description: An imp-clan leader and the imp commander's sister. After taking Ironloch, she directs a large new assault on Hayden's Knoll with airborne troops and underground reinforcements.
characters.name: Lily

characters.description: The Legion commander at the northern transition-point fort. He organizes soldiers and dwarven allies against Lily's airborne attack.
characters.name: Corporal Young

characters.description: A member of Tai's mixed delaying force who accompanies him in the operation to slow the imp army before it reaches Hayden's Knoll.
characters.name: Quimby

characters.description: A dungeon keeper defending the mining complex. He spends his own health to summon dungeon creatures and bosses against the invading force.
characters.name: Drake

characters.description: The leader of goblins fighting beside dwarves and dungeon creatures in defense of the mining complex.
characters.name: Chief Bugtug

characters.description: The elite Imperium Blademaster previously known as Private Blevins. He was working undercover as an investigator and remained near Raytak as a covert bodyguard.
characters.name: Captain Blevins

characters.description: The restored real-world identity of the Legion commander known as Raytak. His recovered memories reconnect him with his wife Natalie, his son Trey, and the rest of his family.
characters.name: James A. Raytak

characters.description: Raytak's wife, remembered when his damaged past returns. She is also receiving MedPod care and can meet him within a shared virtual setting.
characters.name: Natalie

characters.description: Trey's partner and Lauren's mother, who belongs to Raytak's family in the real world.
characters.name: Veronica
